levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: Ruling needed (rule 6, rule 11): «قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ فِي الْبُومَةِ» — the speaker is only a pronoun («سمعته»), with no name in the text; the chain ends at Abu Abd Allah, who is named after «عن» and so stays narrator (owner ruling 2)
«وَ جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي» is a group of shaykhs with no names: unnamed, co-transmitting with Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (rule 2, rule 8)
The archive flag «one position holds two names joined by و» is read as the two co-transmitters of one level
